summary: All 52 manifest entries matched their hashes and sizes. Both selected genes increased in the author and registered results. Only Lepr had a numerical effect pair (+1.14 versus +1.485), well below the 30-gene concordance minimum. The corrected proposal retains `compared` for the two genes and records the discovery discrepancy as `unresolved`. It passed the repository proposal checker.
openIssues: Figure 2A draws fold-change boundaries near ±1, while its caption specifies ±0.5. The authors report discoveries, but none of the 17,136 published registered genes has BH FDR < 0.05. The cause remains unknown.
The full author DESeq2 table and design formula were unavailable. The Dryad Figure 2 archive could not be inspected.
The six GEO samples and the RNA extraction method establish bulk hypothalamic tissue. They do not establish the registry’s arcuate-specific label.
